provenance.selection: Selection (deterministic): for each kind, from every asserted family of the run (``specials`` is record-only and left out), the families in plan order and in each the candidates in f8_model.candidates order: the first device word of the family's recorded mismatches (summary.json ``examples``) that a candidate misses, unless a record already selected for that kind refutes it; then the first ``uniform`` records of the family's uniform sample (fixture.json).  Each record once.  Every selected word equals sm120_gs32_w26_f133's (the run's 0-mismatch candidate); pin asserts it.  ``c`` is the accumulator the first step reads (+0 on enable_input_d = 0 tiles); ``a``/``b`` are 32 codes a step, ``sa``/``sb`` one UE8M0 byte a step (kind::mxf8f6f4 only).
